capabilities: Manage tasks on month, week-agenda, and three-day timeline views
Drag timed task blocks to reschedule by time or day
Create tasks with due dates, time ranges, priorities, and category tags
Mark Chinese lunar dates, statutory holidays, and make-up workdays
Store and read tasks as plain Obsidian checklist lines in archive notes
disambiguation: Not limited to a month grid despite the name; it also offers week views and a three-day timeline with drag-to-reschedule blocks.
extras: README notes the timor.tech backup holiday source currently returns 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so in practice only holiday-cn and the built-in 2022–2026 data work; task archive filenames are always Simplified Chinese regardless of interface language.
intentEvidence: Monthly Tasks is a TickTick-style task view for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian shows tasks only as checkbox lines inside notes, with no month grid or hour-by-hour timeline for planning and drag-scheduling them by date.

relations.evidence: Monthly Tasks is a TickTick-style task view for Obsidian.

summary: TickTick-style task calendar with month, week, and three-day timeline views; stores tasks as Obsidian checklists and marks lunar dates and Chinese holidays.
